expectations.text: Recommends opening with an icebreaker, keyed to the small size of the room.
expectations.evidence: "A 12-person room is small enough for it."

expectations.text: States no participant count that defines when a room is small.

expectations.text: Prompts participants for active participation explicitly rather than assuming it happens.
